:::{#def-random-choice}
#### Choosing at random

Let $S$ be a set with a
[measure](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/measures.html#def-measure) $\measure$
such that $0 < \measure(S) < \infty$.
To **choose an element of $S$ at random** is to run a
[random experiment](#def-random-experiment) whose [sample space](#def-sample-space) is $S$
and whose [probability measure](#def-probability) is the
[uniform distribution](random-variables.qmd#def-uniform-set) on $S$.
:::
